name: Schorndorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Schorndorf (a black antler above crossed tools on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Schorndorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schorndorf arms — antler and tools on yellow
